$comment: Accepted public surfaces for the Tier 1 convex authz probe. Each entry hides one finding from one scanner. Entries expire automatically: after `expires` the finding resurfaces so it gets re-reviewed. Add a suppression only with a written reason and an owner. See README.md.

suppressions.reason: Public marketing contact form by design. Abuse is handled by route-level rate limiting, not authorization; this is not an authz defect.
Documented narrow surface: only transitions to status=failed and is guarded by a terminal-state check. Deliberately public so the Inngest payment worker can mark an order failed.
